name: Operations & Admin
description: Run the everyday office work: agendas, minutes and to-do lists, written procedures, and supplier requests and offer comparisons, all prepared as drafts.

sampleTasks.title: Organise the monthly team meeting for a design studio

sampleTasks.title: Compose a procedure for opening and closing the shop
sampleTasks.description: Draft a step-by-step procedure for opening and closing a small bakery shop each day, with a checklist and who is responsible at each step.

sampleTasks.title: Draft a request for quotes for new office chairs
sampleTasks.description: Compose a request for quotes to three suppliers for ten office chairs, listing our requirements, quantity, delivery place and the date answers are needed.
